gate release.how: To sort an item: link the event to it with depends_on (the event waits for it) or defers (it can follow). To move one across, unlink the link given here and link the other.

handoff repo.how: Everything here is read off the map as it is now, and nothing is written down for the next session. What nobody has seen working is said on the item (seen_working false, what would show it in to_see) and listed as unseen: set it true once someone has. What sessions left on no remote or not committed is read off their checkouts (left). What bites in a file is an instruction kept about this repository with for: file:<glob> (traps), said in brief and when a session opens a file it names: make one when something bites and nothing can fix it, an issue when something can, and retire it when a change to its file makes it untrue. What comes next is read off the open work, by attention within this repository.

to_shape.how: Each of these holds enough to be the hub of its problem and has no view of its own. Give it its views: for each, a lens item (change, type lens) linked about it, named for the question it answers, with place for its order, controls for what the person may change (lit, far, closed), and a style about it if it should look its own way. A lens with from set to another item is a shortcut to there. The view named hubs lists every hub.
